results.title: Fewer family reunification permits granted in Portugal
results.description: More than 24,000 people were still waiting for a decision on family reunification in Portugal at the end of 2025. During the year, AIMA granted 17,359 residence permits to family members – 31% fewer than in 2024.

results.title: Sand supports letting Iowa prison workers bargain as public safety employees
results.description: Democratic gubernatorial candidate Rob Sand said he would support classifying prison employees as public safety workers to give them access to more bargaining rights under Iowa law.
